owners-install.title: Owner's and installation manual
owners-install.desc: Operation, cleaning and troubleshooting, then full installation steps for the system.

remote.title: Remote control manual
remote.desc: Buttons, modes, timers and settings for the wireless remote that ships with the indoor unit.

warranty.title: Limited warranty
warranty.desc: 5-year parts and 7-year compressor coverage under the Blueridge ductless limited warranty. Includes the record form for installer details and serial number.

spec-sheet.title: Specifications sheet
spec-sheet.desc: Dimensions, weights, electrical requirements, line set sizes and maximum lengths for the system.

extended-performance.title: Extended performance data
extended-performance.desc: Heating and cooling capacity, power input and efficiency (COP) across outdoor temperatures.

ahri.title: AHRI certificate 217328208
ahri.desc: Certified ratings for BXS2A09SC0 matched with BXS2A09WM0. Rebate and permit forms often ask for it.

service.title: Service manual
service.desc: Wiring diagrams, refrigerant recharge, error codes and troubleshooting procedures.

system-ratings.title: Ratings
system-ratings.source: Capacity at 95°F and 47°F, SEER2, EER2 and HSPF2: AHRI certificate 217328208, BXS2A09SC0 matched with BXS2A09WM0, issued 14 Jul 2025. Capacity at 5°F and operating range: Blueridge specifications sheet.

indoor-details.title: Unit details
indoor-details.source: From the BXS2A09WM0 specifications on alpinehomeair.com. System efficiency ratings are on AHRI certificate 217328208, listed above.

BXS2A09SC0.name: XS2 9K Single-Zone Outdoor Unit
BXS2A09SC0.lede: Ductless heat pump outdoor unit for one space, matched with the BXS2A09WM0 wall-mount indoor unit.

BXS2A09WM0.name: XS2 9K Wall-Mount Indoor Unit
BXS2A09WM0.lede: Wall-mount indoor unit for one space, matched with the BXS2A09SC0 outdoor unit. Ships with a wireless remote.

BXS2A09SC0-9WM.name: XS2 9K Single-Zone Wall-Mount System
BXS2A09SC0-9WM.lede: Matched ductless heat pump system for one space: the BXS2A09SC0 outdoor unit with the BXS2A09WM0 wall-mount indoor unit.
